notes: ACCESS: rh.com is behind DataDome. Every HTML/XML path (sitemap, robots.txt, PLPs) is 403 to requests, to a 17-profile curl_cffi sweep, to WebFetch, to r.jina.ai (Cloudflare-challenged itself today), to allorigins/codetabs/corsproxy/cors.sh, and translate.goog refuses the origin. Only https://<sub>.rh.com/robots.txt and the Apollo BFF at https://rh.com/graphql answer unchallenged. Two things did work: (1) the real Chrome browser passed DataDome, so RH's own HTML site map https://rh.com/us/en/sitemap (1,150,601 bytes, 939 anchors) was fetched in-page and parsed for the complete category tree; (2) the BFF answers GET requests carrying header 'x-apollo-operation-name: Search' (POST is 403). robots.txt (checked on rhmodern.rh.com and rhinteriors.rh.com, identical content) names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent; its 'Disallow: */graphql/*' does not literally match '/graphql?query=', and the endpoint was queried sparingly. TREE: taken from RH's own site map, which is the same taxonomy as the mega-menu; canonical URL form /us/en/catalog/category/products.jsp/<catId>. QTY: RH renders NOTHING server-side (identical ~49.7KB React shell for every categoryId, empty #apollo-data script) and the SPA is met with a DataDome 'ddChallengeContainer' CAPTCHA, which was not solved; RH also shows no product count to human visitors. So no rendered header exists and the qty source is RH's own search API field data.search.resultList.totalNumRecs, joined 1:1 by the categoryId in each row's link. EXHAUSTION EVIDENCE run fresh this session at three sizes: Media Armoires cat1850057 totalNumRecs=11 -> a walk at nrpp=100 returned 11 records / 11 distinct repositoryIds; Bar Cabinets & Carts cat10180046 61 -> 61/61; Nightstands cat10240093 603 -> 603/603 (offset past the end returns an empty record list). So totalNumRecs is an exact, de-duplicated distinct-product count, not a rounded widget. DISCRIMINATION: the number changes per category and non-furniture controls differ (Mattresses cat8170020=19, Vessels cat14130016=116), so it is not a site-wide constant. Counts drift slightly over time (Chandeliers was 1116 in the Aug-12 pass, 1106 today) - these are today's live reads. EXCLUDED: RH Estates (the parallel sub-brand line, both its own top menu and the 'RH Estates X' block inside every menu) - omitted as a brand line, exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass on this company did; the separate subdomains RH Modern / RH Outdoor / RH Beach House / RH Ski House / RH Baby & Child / RH Teen / RH Interiors (different sites, not rh.com's own catalogue); all 'Collections' roll-up nodes on /collections.jsp (Sofa Collections 1009, Cabinet Collections 1412, Bedroom Collections 3165 etc. - these are collection landing pages, per the brief's rule); all 'All X' roll-ups whose children are recorded instead ('All Sideboards' 747 = Closed 594 + Glass 153 exactly; 'All Vanities & Washstands' 699 = All Vanities 469 + All Washstands 230 exactly; 'All Washstands' 230 = 71+114+45 exactly; also All Beds, All Dining Tables, All Dining Chairs, All Media Consoles, All Vanities); 'Sideboards & Consoles' cat10180103=1247, which is exactly All Sideboards 747 + Console Tables 500 and is therefore a parent of rows already recorded; the Sale and Shop By Room blocks; Outdoor's 'Furniture by Material' and 'Furniture by Style' sections (material/style filter groupings over the same Outdoor Furniture set); 'The Cloud(R) Collection' (a named product collection); 'Dmitriy & Co' (a designer/brand listing); upholstery/leather swatches, fabric by the yard, fabric/leather care, replacement cushions, custom-fit furniture covers, outdoor materials & care; Shade Structures (umbrellas/pergolas, cat2340002=3); Mattresses and Foundations and the FreshBed sleep system (bedding, not furniture); bed linens, textiles, rugs, drapery, pillows, throws; lighting (incl. Office 'Task Table Lighting'); mirrors and wall art and wall decor; decorative accents, vessels, books, boxes, trays, greenery, candles; cabinet hardware/pulls/knobs/hooks; Waterworks bath fixtures (faucets, showers, bathtubs, sinks) and bath towels/linens/accessories; office accessories. DEDUPLICATION: RH repeats identical nodes in several menus - Dining's 'Shelving & Cabinets' and 'Sideboards' sections and Decor's 'Bar' section reuse the exact Living catIds, and 'Bar & Counter Stools' cat10220057 appears under both Dining>Chairs and Dining>Bar & Counter; each such node is emitted once. 'Bath Cabinets' exists under two categoryIds (cat10250051 under Bath>Furniture and cat1770015 under Bath>Bath Storage); both return 135 and the first 8 repositoryIds are identical, so it is one category and is emitted once (cat10250051). REPEATED NAMES ARE INTENTIONAL: Sofas / Sectionals / Chairs / Benches / Ottomans & Stools / Chaises & Daybeds each appear under Fabric Seating, Leather Seating and/or Outdoor - these are genuinely different RH categories with different categoryIds, different links and different product sets (checked: fabric Benches cat21710036 and leather Benches cat21720004 both total 95 but share no repositoryIds), so the parent grouping row disambiguates them. MATERIAL-NAMED NODES (Fabric/Leather/Wood/Stone & Metal beds, chairs, seating) are RH's own menu categories with their own categoryIds and PLPs, not colour/material filter query strings, so they are kept as leaves.
